_comment: RESERVOIR TYPE res_sigmoid_gate: the LogicGates 19i-b realizable gate element used as a reservoir nonlinearity (registered 2026-08-24 on user request: 'sigmoid reservoir'). Provenance: LogicGates data/19ib_highsigma2, the 2026-08 weekend-campaign Pareto point (gap 7.0x). Stack: 20um cyanine-class saturable absorber (sigma 0.108, N1_0 13.3) -> 25um 45-deg-director gain dye (Ey->Ez converter) -> 24um z-director gain dye (amplifier), single Ez pump 0.40 amp 200 (gaussian, start 0, off ~202); drive Ey 0.55 start 60 rides the charging pump = the exact protocol the transfer curve was measured with. MEASURED TRANSFER (Sigma|Ey|^2 in at 0.55 -> Sigma|Ez|^2 out): linear foot ratio ~0.20 (a 0.3-3), avalanche knee / unstable decision crossing S_in 6.3e5 (a~13), peak ratio 2.82 at a20, stable ON crossing S_in 4.4e6 (a~34), depletion fold beyond a~50 -> the sigmoid + fold nonlinearity this type contributes. PUMP MUST STAY Ez: the z-amp pump line is [0,0,1]-oriented. Monitors kept MINIMAL for 1000-sample dataset generation (two 1Ddft lines only - no pop monitor, no snaps; the LogicGates originals carry the diagnostics). IPC datasets: 4 input strips via generate_ipc_data.py --n_sources 4 (in-memory amplitude-list override, no design copy - amplitude here stays the faithful 2-strip [10,10] of the sweep design); --scale 30 puts the per-strip drive u*30 (u~U[-1,1]) mid-transition: mean total S_in ~ 3734*scale^2/3 = 1.1e6 sits between decision (6.3e5) and ON (4.4e6), max ~3.4e6 reaches saturation, small |u| samples the linear foot. Solver key says gpumeep; the lips CPU script forces RESERVOIR_SOLVER=meep. See scripts/slurm_ipc_lips.sh.

source_1._comment: DRIVE: Ey gaussian at 0.55, start 60 (rides the charging pump - the measured-transfer protocol). 2-element amplitude = 2 x 5um strips (faithful to the sweep design); IPC generation overrides to 4 x 2.5um strips via --n_sources 4.

source_pump._comment: PUMP: Ez@0.40 amp 200 (15-series style): 50% coupling to the 45-deg region, 100% to the z-region.

absorber._comment: SA dye, 20 um, sigma 0.108 / N1_0 13.3 (empirical OD match to 19g's foot).

gain_conv._comment: 45-deg converter region (same dye as gain_amp, local director tilted 45 deg).

gain_amp._comment: FULL-z amplifier: same dye, director along z. 24 um (19e 18 + 6 for peak ~2.6).
